text:
alice_pm: Hey team — quick sync on error semantics we need for the upcoming chat+tools + structured-output launch. Goal: 1) consistent shape across endpoints, 2) clear mapping to HTTP status codes, 3) prioritized list for MVP vs v1, and 4) fallback/route rules when models or tools are unavailable.

ben_runtime: +1. We should keep the initial set small. Too many error codes means more complexity in SDKs and tests.

carmen_ml: Customers asked for explicit `model_unavailable` and `quality_regression` codes — they want automated fallback. We should define both an HTTP and internal `code` field.

dan_security: Also need to make sure Security gets a 403/401 contract plus consistent audit metadata (request_id, org_id) returned in error bodies for audits.

ella_support: From support side: require Retry-After for rate limits and model-level backoffs. If a tool fails, include tool.name and tool.error so we can trace.

ben_runtime: Proposed minimal HTTP -> internal mapping for MVP: 
- 400 -> validation_error (bad prompt payload, schema mismatch)
- 401 -> authentication_error
- 403 -> authorization_error (policy, pii blocked)
- 404 -> resource_not_found (model id, tool name)
- 409 -> conflict_error (concurrent model-version pin mismatch)
- 422 -> deserialization_error / structured_output_invalid
- 429 -> rate_limited / quota_exceeded (include Retry-After header)
- 502 -> upstream_error (model proxying failure)
- 503 -> model_unavailable / transient_capacity
- 500 -> inference_failure / internal_error

carmen_ml: Agree but add `inference_timeout` as a distinct internal code mapped to 504 gateway_timeout. We see this frequently on long-tool chains.

alice_pm: That looks reasonable. For the error JSON shape, can we standardize on: 
```json
{
  "error": {
    "code": "string",    // e.g. \"model_unavailable\"
    "message": "string",
    "details": ["..."],
    "request_id": "string",
    "retry_after": "number|null"
  }
}
```
This keeps it flat and easy for SDKs.

ben_runtime: Agree on shape. Implementation notes: always set request_id header X-Request-Id and mirror in error body. `retry_after` only for 429/503 transients. `details` can include structured bits for tool errors, e.g. `\{"tool":"browser_search","err":"timeout"\}` as a JSON string inside details.

ella_support: For tool calling errors, suggest this example snippet returned on tool failure: 
```json
{
  "error": {
    "code": "tool_error",
    "message": "browser_search timed out",
    "details": ["tool.name=browser_search","tool.err=timeout"],
    "request_id": "r1234",
    "retry_after": null
  }
}
```
This helps us correlate quickly.

carmen_ml: Routing/fallback policy proposal: if `model_unavailable` -> auto-route to fallback model (configurable per customer). If fallback not configured, return 503 with `code=model_unavailable` and `retry_after`. For quality_regression (v1), return 200 with `warnings` vs a hard error? We need product decision.

alice_pm: Product preference: for launch, keep behavior simple: if model produces invalid structured output -> return 422 + `code=structured_output_invalid` and include the failing field path in `details`. Warnings (non-blocking) can be surfaced in telemetry and in response `warnings` field but not block. We can revisit `quality_regression` as an alerting-only signal in v1.

dan_security: Important: any response that contains PII-redaction decisions should include `redaction_applied=true` inside `details` and a `redaction_policy_id` so audit logs can link back.

ben_runtime: Prioritization: Phase 1 (MVP - must have before GA): consistent error shape, 400/401/403/404/422/429/500/503, request_id in header & body, Retry-After for 429/503, basic tool_error mapping. Phase 2: more granular internal codes (conflict_error, inference_timeout, desync), per-endpoint docs, SDK helpers to map to exceptions. Phase 3: quality_regression code + automated routing for canaries and per-customer fallback.

ella_support: Launch criteria from support POV: error docs live + examples, playbook for common errors (rate limit, model_unavailable, tool_timeouts), and instrumentation so support can filter by `error.code`.

alice_pm: Engineering acceptance criteria:
- Unit tests for error shape in each endpoint
- Integration test verifying request_id propagation and Retry-After flows
- SLO/alerts: 5xx rate < 0.5% (per-model), 429 spikes alert if >3x baseline in 5m window
- Docs + example error payloads in product docs

carmen_ml: Can we also add an evaluation hook that tags a request as `eval=true` (header) so errors from eval traffic don't trigger alerts?

ben_runtime: Yes, we will honor X-Eval-Traffic header. Also add `ci-bot` to log noisily when new error codes get added.

ci-bot: Noted. I will post a CI alert if new error codes/constants are introduced in the runtime repo.

alice_pm: One open negotiation: customers want per-endpoint error subcodes (e.g., embeddings -> vector_size_mismatch). Engineering wants to avoid explosion. Proposal: allow an extensible `details` key and a small canonical set of `error.code` values for cross-endpoint handling. Per-endpoint subcodes can go into details like `subcode=vector_size_mismatch`. Thoughts?

ella_support: That would work for support if we enforce a structured `details` convention (comma-separated key=val or JSON string).

ben_runtime: Fine by me. We'll enforce `details` being either an array of strings key=val or a single JSON string. Keep SDKs able to parse both.

alice_pm: Final action items:
- ben_runtime: implement error shape + headers + 429/503 Retry-After (sprint 1)
- carmen_ml: add model_unavailable handling and suggest fallback logic (sprint 1)
- dan_security: define audit fields and 403 cases (end of sprint 1)
- ella_support: draft playbook & examples (sprint 1)
- docs: product to publish canonical examples and mapping table (phase 1 doc)

ben_runtime: I'll open an RFC PR with mappings, example payloads, and integration tests.

alice_pm: Great — thanks. If folks agree, I'll mark this as the roadmap decision for the launch error contract. Reply with :+1: to ack or call out concerns.

ben_runtime: :+1:

carmen_ml: :+1:

dan_security: :+1:

ella_support: +1 — one thing: please make sure `retry_after` is documented as seconds (integer) and clients respect fractional seconds as floor.

alice_pm: Noted — will add that to docs. Thanks everyone.
